The flagship is designed for outpatient specialties that work from consultation and examination rooms. Specialty mix will be confirmed as planning progresses — tell us yours when you register.

physicians.q: What will participation cost, and how will it work?
physicians.a: Flexible lease options — for example by the hour, day or month — are planned. Rates and terms are not yet published; we will share details directly with interested physicians once they are confirmed.
The proposed model includes reception and patient flow, administrative support and common facility standards. Integrated laboratory services are planned for a later phase, subject to approvals.
WAHP will operate in full compliance with applicable Ghanaian healthcare and facility regulations. Licensing and regulatory processes are being pursued in accordance with national standards.

physicians.q: What happens after I register interest?
physicians.a: A member of the WAHP team reviews your details and follows up by email to understand your practice and keep you informed as the flagship develops.

patients.a: Not yet. WAHP is pre-launch and is not seeing patients. We will announce clearly when services are available.
The first facility is planned for Accra, Ghana. We will share the location once it is confirmed.
No. WAHP provides infrastructure for independent physicians. Patients will see independent physicians who practise from the facility.
Use the general enquiry option on our contact page. Please don't include any health information.

diaspora.q: Do I need to move back to Ghana?
diaspora.a: No. The practice path is designed so you could start during the weeks you are already home and grow from there. Nothing here asks for an irreversible decision.

diaspora.q: Can I practise in Ghana with a licence from abroad?
diaspora.a: Physicians remain responsible for meeting Ghanaian requirements to practise, including registration with the Medical and Dental Council. WAHP does not handle registration on your behalf.

diaspora.q: What does the partner path involve?
diaspora.a: Contributing through networks, advice or experience building institutions. Any formal role is discussed privately and individually. Investment enquiries go through the investor page; nothing on this site is an offer of securities.
